---
title: "01_load"
format: html
---

Load \`tidyverse\` and resolve paths relative to the project root so the
document renders reproducibly from either \`R/\` or the top-level directory.

```{r}
#| message: false
#| warning: false

library("tidyverse")

root_dir <- if (basename(getwd()) == "R") ".." else "."
raw_meta_dir <- file.path(root_dir, "data", "_raw", "metadata")
raw_res_dir <- file.path(root_dir, "data", "_raw", "resultsData")
data_dir <- file.path(root_dir, "data")

dir.create(path = raw_meta_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(path = raw_res_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
```

## Retrieve Raw Data

Verify that all ISA-Tab metadata and metabolite tables from MetaboLights
study `MTBLS14208` are present in `data/_raw/`, downloading any missing files.

```{r}
#| message: false

base_url <- str_c(
  "http://ftp.ebi.ac.uk/pub/databases/metabolights/",
  "studies/public/MTBLS14208"
)

meta_files <- c(
  "s_MTBLS14208.txt",
  "a_MTBLS14208_LC-MS_positive_hilic.txt",
  "a_MTBLS14208_LC-MS_negative_hilic.txt"
)

res_files <- c(
  "m_MTBLS14208_LC-MS_positive_hilic_v2_maf.tsv",
  "m_MTBLS14208_LC-MS_negative_hilic_v2_maf.tsv"
)

walk(meta_files, \(f) {
  dest <- file.path(raw_meta_dir, f)
  if (!file.exists(dest)) {
    download.file(url = str_c(base_url, "/", f), destfile = dest)
  }
})

walk(res_files, \(f) {
  dest <- file.path(raw_res_dir, f)
  if (!file.exists(dest)) {
    download.file(url = str_c(base_url, "/", f), destfile = dest)
  }
})
```

## Load and Save Raw Tables

Read the raw tab-separated files and write compressed intermediate tables to
`data/` for downstream cleaning in `02_clean.qmd`.

```{r}
#| message: false

samples_raw <- read_tsv(
  file = file.path(raw_meta_dir, "s_MTBLS14208.txt"),
  show_col_types = FALSE
)

assay_pos_raw <- read_tsv(
  file = file.path(raw_meta_dir, "a_MTBLS14208_LC-MS_positive_hilic.txt"),
  show_col_types = FALSE
)

assay_neg_raw <- read_tsv(
  file = file.path(raw_meta_dir, "a_MTBLS14208_LC-MS_negative_hilic.txt"),
  show_col_types = FALSE
)

metab_pos_raw <- read_tsv(
  file = file.path(
    raw_res_dir,
    "m_MTBLS14208_LC-MS_positive_hilic_v2_maf.tsv"
  ),
  show_col_types = FALSE
)

metab_neg_raw <- read_tsv(
  file = file.path(
    raw_res_dir,
    "m_MTBLS14208_LC-MS_negative_hilic_v2_maf.tsv"
  ),
  show_col_types = FALSE
)

write_tsv(samples_raw, file.path(data_dir, "01_samples_load.tsv.gz"))
write_tsv(assay_pos_raw, file.path(data_dir, "01_assay_pos_load.tsv.gz"))
write_tsv(assay_neg_raw, file.path(data_dir, "01_assay_neg_load.tsv.gz"))
write_tsv(metab_pos_raw, file.path(data_dir, "01_metab_pos_load.tsv.gz"))
write_tsv(metab_neg_raw, file.path(data_dir, "01_metab_neg_load.tsv.gz"))
```

## Quick Inspection

Check the dimensions and column names of the loaded datasets.

```{r}
tibble(
  dataset = c(
    "samples", "assay_pos", "assay_neg",
    "metab_pos", "metab_neg"
  ),
  rows = c(
    nrow(samples_raw), nrow(assay_pos_raw), nrow(assay_neg_raw),
    nrow(metab_pos_raw), nrow(metab_neg_raw)
  ),
  cols = c(
    ncol(samples_raw), ncol(assay_pos_raw), ncol(assay_neg_raw),
    ncol(metab_pos_raw), ncol(metab_neg_raw)
  )
)

colnames(samples_raw)
colnames(metab_pos_raw)
```
